newsitem.title: USA: Smith's Food & Drug repays loans.
newsitem.headline: Smith's Food & Drug repays loans.

text.p: Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc said Friday it plans to make voluntary prepayments totaling $100 million on its bank term loans.
The company made a $10 million prepayment on December 31, 1996, shortly after the fiscal year end on December 28th.
Another prepayment of $40 million will be made today and an additional $50 million prepayment is scheduled to be made on January 15, 1997.
These payments are in addition to the $50 million prepayment on September 30, 1996 and result in total voluntary prepayments of $150 million since the recapitalization of the Company in May of 1996.

The company said it is able to make the voluntary prepayments primarily due to additional asset sales from the divestiture from California and related tax benefits received in addition to cash flow from operations.
The company expects it will announce fourth quarter results on January 28.
